description: Create an endpoint's shareable link and return it. With no other arguments the link stays restricted: workspace members can open it (they sign in), which is enough for a PR or an internal message. Only when the user asks to share it outside the workspace: set `link_access` to `viewer` (anyone with the link can read) or `commenter` (Team plan; commenting asks for sign-in), or `invite` people by email (they get an email and sign in with that address). `restricted` turns the public link off; the URL stays the same. The page is read-only and always hides credentials and secrets.

endpoint_id.description: Id of the endpoint. Alternative to method + path.

invite.description: People to invite by email (at most 10). Each gets an email.

link_access.description: Who can open it with just the link. Omit to keep the current setting (restricted for a new share).

method.description: HTTP method of the route, e.g. POST. Use with path instead of endpoint_id.

path.description: Route path as written in the code, e.g. /v1/charges/:id or /v1/charges/{id}.

name: share_api_endpoint
